fixed_protocol.scope: ADE20K Train only, unchanged previous image IDs and cached patch positions
fixed_protocol.preprocessing: Whole RGB image, short side 384 with aspect ratio, bilinear RGB, nearest GT, pad right/bottom to Patch16; final LN excludes CLS + four registers; FP32 L2-normalized cache
fixed_protocol.regimes: At least 128 non-ignore GT pixels; Interior purity >= .90; Mixed .50 <= purity < .90. Each regime queries its own bank only.
fixed_protocol.sampling: Reuse one candidate per image/class/regime with max 64 images per class/regime; eligible classes have >=8 images in both regimes.
fixed_protocol.queries: All eligible cached rows are both query and candidate; mask all same-image candidates before rank. No query-image holds out other query images.
fixed_protocol.tie_break: FP32 cosine, descending; exact ties follow ascending immutable cache row.
fixed_protocol.retrieval: Precision at k is fraction same class in top k. Hit at k is at least one same class in top k. MRR uses first true match in entire eligible rank, zero if absent.
fixed_protocol.random_frequency: Exact expected scores under uniform random permutation of eligible patches without replacement.
fixed_protocol.random_balanced: Exact expected scores under uniform eligible class then uniform patch, independent draws; MRR truncated to eligible candidate count.
fixed_protocol.aggregation: Micro weights each query or triplet equally, Macro first averages within each anchor class then over classes with support. Pooled All combines the two disjoint searches.
fixed_protocol.retention: Overlap |teacher top k ∩ student top k| / k. Same-class identity retention conditions on Teacher hits, with both per-query averages and pooled matched hits.
fixed_protocol.pairs: Each Teacher rank j=1..5 paired with one independent uniform rank k in each fixed lower band [6,10], [11,50], [51,200], [201,N]. k and j may come from the same candidate image; neither can come from the query image. Same pairs for all models. GT unused for choosing ranks.
fixed_protocol.teacher_confidence: Quintiles of top1 score, 1−5 and 1−10 gap within each regime. Pair confidence is Teacher margin quintile, top fifth is high-margin. The same quantile is also computed within each fixed lower-rank band to check whether the pooled top fifth is driven by far ranks. The joint near slice uses j=1, k=6–10, cosine in the top fifth of queries, and margin in the top fifth of the near band. Margin bins are diagnostic only.
fixed_protocol.violation: Teacher margin > 0 and Student margin <= 0. Exact Teacher ties excluded from denominator.
fixed_protocol.semantic_relevance: Interior same→different is the strict semantic-relevant subset. Same→same and different→different do not establish a semantic ranking; different→same can be an inverted Teacher relation. All Mixed rows remain ambiguous, their dominant-class analogues are descriptive.
fixed_protocol.relative_hyperparameters: No learned thresholds or optimization; K=1,5,10 is reporting only. Diagnostic ADE labels and selected IDs stay in this results directory.
fixed_protocol.array_layout: top_rows/top_scores [model, query, top-rank]; pair arrays [query, lower-band, upper-rank]; cosine_pairs [model, query, lower-band, upper-rank, (upper,lower)]; rows index original cache.
fixed_protocol.metrics_precision: raw values are fractions except baseline ADE mIoU and PACO AP; report renders most fractions as percent.
